name: Foreign Exchange Trade Confirmation Status Advice Acknowledgement V 02
definition: Scope|The ForeignExchangeTradeConfirmationStatusAdviceAcknowledgement message is sent from a market participant to a Central matching utility (CMU) in response to the FXTradeConfirmationStatusAdvice previously sent by the CMU in the scenario of trades matched by both participants.||Usage|The acknowledgement is sent by the trading member to the CMU after they received the confirmation status advice. |Note that one confirmation status advice acknowledgement responds to one confirmation status advice.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date on which the trade was executed.

TradeIdentification.name: Trade Identification
TradeIdentification.definition: Unique reference identification assigned to the trade by the instructing party. This reference will be used throughout the trade life cycle to identify the particular trade.

TradingMode.name: Trading Mode
TradingMode.definition: Identifies the type of the trade mode.

AffirmationStatus.name: Affirmation Status
AffirmationStatus.definition: Identifies the status of the confirmation acknowledgement.

ConfirmationStatus.name: Confirmation Status
ConfirmationStatus.definition: Identifies the status of the confirmation.

MarketIdentification.name: Market Identification
MarketIdentification.definition: Market in which a trade transaction has been executed.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
